summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Book-a-demo modal flow and the real Simple Icons partner-logo strip. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_demo_api.py (pytest, 7 cases) — all pass, including happy-path persistence with pre/post GET /api/demo/count delta, 422 validation for invalid email, missing required field, and empty name. Frontend: Playwright sweep against the public preview URL — all four Book-a-demo entry points (nav-book-demo, hero-book-demo, pricing-cta-scale, final-book-demo) open the same modal (data-testid=demo-modal), modal closes via demo-modal-close (X) and via demo-modal-overlay, full form submission triggers POST /api/demo → 201, demo-success renders with the confirmation copy including the submitted email, and the backend count increments by exactly 1 (verified 3 → 4). Social proof strip renders 18 tags (9 unique brands × 2 for marquee) — GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, Linear, Stripe, Shopify, Datadog, Sentry, Notion — all with naturalWidth > 0 (none broken). Section header 'Trusted by engineering teams that ship daily.' and 'Marcus Devlin, Staff Engineer' testimonial intact. Banned-word audit clean: no 'contact us', 'up to', 'starting from', '$1m', '1 million'. Zero page errors; the single console 'error' is the expected 422 from our own invalid-email validation probe.

critical_code_review_comments: Info: server.py returns the raw ObjectId via alias '_id' inside DemoRequest — the PyObjectId BeforeValidator stringifies it, so the JSON response contains a string 'id' field. No ObjectId serialization leak observed in the POST /api/demo response. Good.
Info: DemoRequestIn uses EmailStr (validates email format) and min_length=1 on name/company/team_size — validation surface is correct. 422 returned in all three negative cases.
Minor: server.py has no explicit index on demo_requests. For scale, consider a compound index on (email, created_at) or at least a TTL/created_at index. Non-blocking for MVP.
Minor: CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True. FastAPI/Starlette silently rejects credentials when origin is '*', which is fine here (no auth), but be aware once auth is added.

Minor: DemoModal.jsx catches ALL fetch failures into a single generic 'Something went wrong.' error — a 422 (validation) will be indistinguishable from a network error in the UI. Not part of this iteration's acceptance criteria; consider surfacing the server's Pydantic error detail for a nicer UX.
Minor (from iter 1, still present): ScrollExpandShowcase logs two framer-motion 'container has a non-static position' warnings; non-blocking.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on demo endpoints
seed_data_creation: 6 demo_requests documents inserted with TEST_/playwright_test_ prefixes across pytest and one UI submission. Non-destructive; can be dropped via db.demo_requests.delete_many({email: /^test_|^playwright_test_/i}) if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo modal + backend persistence + real logo strip all green. Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_demo_api.py — reuse for any future changes to /api/demo. Frontend Playwright coverage covered: 4 CTA entry points, X + overlay close, happy-path submit with count delta, brand-logo integrity (9 unique via cdn.simpleicons.org), banned-word audit, page-error count. If the modal gains new fields (e.g. phone) or the endpoint adds new validation, extend TestDemoCreate accordingly.
